name: Gargamox
blurb: Worthless trash granted power freely by the Filth Devil in a mockery of the Black Sacrament — beggars, outcasts and the depraved who wield the Plague Winds that scour flesh from bone. Area denial and damage over time.
playstyle: Area denial and damage over time.

specialMechanic.name: Plague
specialMechanic.text: A unit affected by plague takes 1 toxic damage at the end of its turn, then discards a plague token. This damage can't be reduced or ignored but can't slay. Gargamox units don't take plague damage or remove plague tokens.

specialTags.Infect: Jumps from the original target up to three times to adjacent characters.
specialTags.Deathburst: An effect that triggers when this unit is slain.
specialTags.Hazard: A unit starting its turn in, or entering, a hazard takes 1 damage ignoring armor.

traits.name: Blessed with Filth
traits.text: Immune to hazards. At turn start, gain 1 plague, then may distribute plague tokens on this unit to units in range 2.

acts.name: Virulence
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage and inflict 1 plague. Then may remove a plague token on target to deal 1 toxic damage, again (3+) one more, (5+) one more.

souls.name: Infest
souls.text: Turn start: grant 2 plague tokens to a unit in range.

souls.name: Slime Form
souls.text: Turn start: MOVE with free movement through walls and units. After, push or pull all units in range 2 one (5+) two spaces.

traits.name: Toxic Revenge
traits.text: Deathburst: Splash (self) 1 plague, and 1 toxic damage to already-plagued foes.

traits.name: Thrall
traits.text: 2 per unit slot; may activate two at a time.

acts.name: Pseudopod
acts.text: Pull unit one space. Gains +1 range and pull for each plague token on this unit.

upgrades.name: Aftermath
upgrades.text: Pseudopod inflicts 1 slow on plagued units.

upgrades.name: Massive Swell
upgrades.text: Toxic Revenge leaves a hazard instead of a corpse.

upgrades.name: Tentacle Whip
upgrades.text: Toxic Revenge's splash pushes 1 if this unit is plagued.

traits.name: Plaguebearer
traits.text: Immune to hazards. May treat plague tokens as strength.

acts.name: Pustulate
acts.text: Create a hazard in a free space in range 3 and inflict plague on an adjacent target, (4+) all adjacent targets.

acts.name: Vomitous Mass
acts.text: Line 4: 1 plague. Already-plagued foes gain 1 slow.

acts.name: Rotblade
acts.text: On hit: 1 toxic damage and infect: 1 toxic damage.

upgrades.name: Catalyze
upgrades.text: Vomitous Mass deals 1 toxic damage to units standing in hazards.

upgrades.name: Invigorating Viscera
upgrades.text: Gain deathburst: splash (self) 1 plague, and allies gain 1 strength.

upgrades.name: Smog Shroud
upgrades.text: Curseproof and cover from all directions while standing in a hazard.

traits.name: Afflicted
traits.text: A Gargamox scion that spreads corruption through curses.

acts.name: Suppurate
acts.text: Unit permanently gains deathburst: splash (self) 1 toxic damage and 1 plague. Stacks with other deathbursts.

acts.name: Evolve Strain
acts.text: Strip all plague from a unit in range. Foes take 1 toxic damage, then gain 1 slow per token removed. Allies gain 1 strength per token removed.

acts.name: Swell with Corruption
acts.text: Unit triggers deathburst without being slain.

upgrades.name: Deathwash
upgrades.text: Has deathburst: splash (self) remove any 1 token from all units in the area.

upgrades.name: Pandemic
upgrades.text: Evolve Strain removes 1 plague from all adjacent characters instead, with the same effects.

upgrades.name: Acid Blood
upgrades.text: Suppurate also grants deathburst: create a hazard instead of a corpse.

traits.name: Swarm Release
traits.text: Deathburst: create a hazard under units in range 2 equal to this unit's plague tokens.

acts.name: Propagate Swarm
acts.text: Create one, (3+) two, or (5+) three hazards in range. May spend a plague token to re-roll the effect die once.

acts.name: Driving Vermin
acts.text: On hit: 2 damage and pull 1. Infect: 1 damage and pull 1. Allies take no damage.

upgrades.name: Swarm Feed
upgrades.text: May spend plague tokens to gain +1D on Driving Vermin per token spent.

upgrades.name: Toxic Avenger
upgrades.text: Immune to hazards. While standing in a hazard, gain 1 plague at turn start.

upgrades.name: Defiler
upgrades.text: Driving Vermin gains effect (5+): create a hazard under target before the attack.

traits.name: Vile Rupture
traits.text: Deathburst: remove up to three plague on this unit, then splash (self) 1 toxic damage once per plague removed.

acts.name: Percolate
acts.text: Inflict two, (5+) or three plague on self, then may inflict 1 slow on an adjacent unit per plague token gained.

acts.name: Surge
acts.text: MOVE with free movement in a straight line, immune to hazards, through walls and units. Foes passed through take 1 toxic damage and may receive this unit's plague.

upgrades.name: Rotten Surge
upgrades.text: After Surge, inflict 1 plague on self for each unit passed through.

upgrades.name: Sticky Trail
upgrades.text: During Surge, may create a hazard in one space passed through.

upgrades.name: The Gunk
upgrades.text: Surge inflicts 2 slow on the first unit affected.
